scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-meesae "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/ensure-dev-secrets.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-meesae-test "vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.mts"
scripts.emulators: node scripts/ensure-dev-secrets.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-meesae
scripts.deploy:web: EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATOR=0 expo export --platform web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:backend: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore,storage
scripts.emulators:persist: node scripts/ensure-dev-secrets.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-meesae --import .emulator-data --export-on-exit .emulator-data
